description: Comprehensive product information scraped from Amazon /dp/ pages — title, ASIN, price, list price, stars, reviews count, in-stock flag, brand, breadcrumb categories, bestseller ranks, seller, delivery info, variants, images, features, and description. One record per scraped product. Empty / null fields are dropped at push time, so any field documented below may be absent if the source did not populate it.

products.description: Dataset containing all scraped Amazon product records.
